missing_components.description: Relationship to handle the linking of rentals to customers is missing.
Workflow for handling payment processing errors is missing.

risks.description: Potential data integrity issue due to lack of relationship between rental transactions and customers.
risks.impact: Inability to accurately manage and track customer-specific rental transactions.

risks.description: Missing error handling for payment processing could lead to unrecorded transaction failures.
risks.impact: Loss of revenue and customer dissatisfaction.

recommendations.action: Define a relationship between rental items and customers to link transactions.
Implement a payment processing error handling workflow.
